label: 85 · Array Rows
description: A type "array" prop, declared plainly and edited as rows: flavor objectRows + columns in the panel, and on the canvas every cell is a leaf handle - bindPropPath with a path AND a kind, onClear removing the row, and the empty last row bound as the add handle.

items.label: Items
items.description: Up to 6 rows of {sku, qty, color}. flavor objectRows + columns edits them as a form; on the canvas every cell is a leaf handle (bindPropPath with a path AND a kind), an empty qty removes its row, and the empty last row adds one.
